lines.gurmukhi: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਜਮਕੰਕਰਾ ਨੋ ਆਖਿ ਛਡਿਆ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਨੋ ਤਿਥੈ ਖੜਿ ਪਾਇਹੁ ਜਿਥੈ ਮਹਾ ਮਹਾਂ ਹਤਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: dharam raai jamaka(n)karaa no aakh chhadiaa es tape no tithai khaR paaihu jithai mahaa mahaa(n) hatiaariaa ||
lines.translation: The Righteous Judge of Dharma said to the Messenger of Death, "Take this penitent and put him with the worst of the worst murderers."

lines.gurmukhi: ਫਿਰਿ ਏਸੁ ਤਪੇ ਦੈ ਮੁਹਿ ਕੋਈ ਲਗਹੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਏਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਹੈ ਫਿਟਕਾਰਿਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: phir es tape dai muhi koee lagahu naahee ehu satigur hai phitakaariaa ||
lines.translation: No one is to look at the face of this penitent again. He has been cursed by the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਦਰਿ ਵਰਤਿਆ ਸੁ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ॥ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਜੁ ਦਯਿ ਸਵਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har kai dar varatiaa s naanak aakh sunaaiaa || so boojhai j day savaariaa ||1||
lines.translation: Nanak speaks and reveals what has taken place in the Court of the Lord. He alone understands, who is blessed and adorned by the Lord. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa(n) har aaraadhiaa har kee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: The devotees of the Lord worship and adore the Lord, and the glorious greatness of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਭਗਤ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਂਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har keeratan bhagat nit gaa(n)vade har naam sukhadaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord's devotees continually sing the Kirtan of His Praises; the Name of the Lord is the Giver of peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਨਿਤ ਨਾਵੈ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਬਖਸੀਅਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa(n) no nit naavai dee vadiaaee bakhaseean nit chaRai savaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord ever bestows upon His devotees the glorious greatness of His Name, which increases day by day.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਨੋ ਥਿਰੁ ਘਰੀ ਬਹਾਲਿਅਨੁ ਅਪਣੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagataa(n) no thir gharee bahaalian apanee paij rakhaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord inspires His devotees to sit, steady and stable, in the home of their inner being. He preserves their honor.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿੰਦਕਾਂ ਪਾਸਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੰਗਸੀ ਬਹੁ ਦੇਇ ਸਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ni(n)dakaa(n) paasahu har lekhaa ma(n)gasee bahu dei sajaaee ||
lines.translation: The Lord summons the slanderers to answer for their accounts, and He punishes them severely.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹਾ ਨਿੰਦਕ ਅਪਣੈ ਜੀਇ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਹੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehaa ni(n)dak apanai jeei kamaavade teho phal paaee ||
lines.translation: As the slanderers think of acting, so are the fruits they obtain.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਮਾਣਾ ਸਰਪਰ ਉਘੜੈ ਭਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਬਹਿ ਧਰਤੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕਮਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: a(n)dar kamaanaa sarapar ughaRai bhaavai koee bahi dharatee vich kamaaee ||
lines.translation: Actions done in secrecy are sure to come to light, even if one does it underground.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਵਿਗਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak dekh vigasiaa har kee vadiaaee ||2||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak blossoms forth in joy, beholding the glorious greatness of the Lord. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਕਾ ਰਾਖਾ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਕਿਆ ਪਾਪੀ ਕਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat janaa(n) kaa raakhaa har aap hai kiaa paapee kareeai ||
lines.translation: The Lord Himself is the Protector of His devotees; what can the sinner do to them?

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਮੂੜ ਗੁਮਾਨੀਆ ਵਿਸੁ ਖਾਧੀ ਮਰੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: gumaan karahi mooR gumaaneeaa vis khaadhee mareeai ||
lines.translation: The proud fool acts in pride, and eating his own poison, he dies.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਇ ਲਗੇ ਨੀ ਦਿਹ ਥੋੜੜੇ ਜਿਉ ਪਕਾ ਖੇਤੁ ਲੁਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: aai lage nee dih thoRaRe jiu pakaa khet luneeai ||
lines.translation: His few days have come to an end, and he is cut down like the crop at harvest.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਤੇਵੇਹੋ ਭਣੀਐ ॥
lines.transliteration: jehe karam kamaavade teveho bhaneeai ||
lines.translation: According to one's actions, so is one spoken of.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਾ ਖਸਮੁ ਵਡਾ ਹੈ ਸਭਨਾ ਦਾ ਧਣੀਐ ॥੩੦॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kaa khasam vadaa hai sabhanaa daa dhaneeai ||30||
lines.translation: Glorious and great is the Lord and Master of servant Nanak; He is the Master of all. ||30||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Salok, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੂਲਹੁ ਭੁਲਿਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਲਬੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh moolahu bhuliaa vich lab lobh aha(n)kaar ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs forget the Primal Lord, the Source of all; they are caught in greed and egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਝਗੜਾ ਕਰਦਿਆ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਗੁਦਰੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰਹਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: jhagaRaa karadiaa anadin gudarai sabad na karahi veechaar ||
lines.translation: They pass their nights and days in conflict and struggle; they do not contemplate the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਧਿ ਮਤਿ ਕਰਤੈ ਸਭ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਈ ਬੋਲਨਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: sudh mat karatai sabh hir laee bolan sabh vikaar ||
lines.translation: The Creator has taken away all their understanding and purity; all their speech is evil and corrupt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦਿਤੈ ਕਿਤੈ ਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਅਹਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਅੰਧੵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ditai kitai na sa(n)tokheeahi a(n)tar tisanaa bahu agiaan a(n)dhyaar ||
lines.translation: No matter what they are given, they are not satisfied; within their hearts there is great desire, ignorance and darkness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨਮੁਖਾ ਨਾਲੋ ਤੁਟੀ ਭਲੀ ਜਿਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak manamukhaa naalo tutee bhalee jin maaiaa moh piaar ||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, it is good to break away from the self-willed manmukhs, who have love and attachment to Maya. ||1||

lines.transliteration: mah 4 ||
lines.translation: Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਾ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ ਹੈ ਤਿਨੑਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinaa a(n)dar doojaa bhaau hai tinhaa guramukh preet na hoi ||
lines.translation: Those whose hearts are filled with the love of duality, do not love the Gurmukhs.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਹੁ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਇ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਸੁਪਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: ohu aavai jaai bhavaaeeai supanai sukh na koi ||
lines.translation: They come and go, and wander in reincarnation; even in their dreams, they find no peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਕੂੜੁ ਉਚਰੈ ਕੂੜਿ ਲਗਿਆ ਕੂੜੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kooR kamaavai kooR ucharai kooR lagiaa kooR hoi ||
lines.translation: They practice falsehood and they speak falsehood; attached to falsehood, they become false.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੈ ਦੁਖਿ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: maaiaa mohu sabh dukh hai dukh binasai dukh roi ||
lines.translation: The love of Maya is total pain; in pain they perish, and in pain they cry out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਤੁ ਲਿਵੈ ਜੋੜੁ ਨ ਆਵਈ ਜੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak dhaat livai joR na aavaee je lochai sabh koi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, there can be no union between the love of worldliness and the love of the Lord, no matter how much everyone may desire it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਪਇਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jin kau potai pu(n)n paiaa tinaa gurasabadee sukh hoi ||2||
lines.translation: Those who have the treasure of virtuous deeds find peace through the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee mah 5 ||
lines.translation: Pauree, Fifth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਵੀਚਾਰਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨਾਂ ਚਾਰਿ ਵੇਦ ਕਹੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak veechaarahi sa(n)t mun janaa(n) chaar ved kaha(n)de ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the Saints and the silent sages think, and the four Vedas proclaim,

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਗਤ ਮੁਖੈ ਤੇ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਸੇ ਵਚਨ ਹੋਵੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhagat mukhai te bolade se vachan hova(n)de ||
lines.translation: that whatever the Lord's devotees speak comes to pass.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਰਗਟ ਪਾਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਪਦੇ ਸਭਿ ਲੋਕ ਸੁਣੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paragat paahaarai jaapade sabh lok suna(n)de ||
lines.translation: He is revealed in His cosmic workshop; all people hear of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਨਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਨਰ ਸੰਤ ਨਾਲਿ ਖਹੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sukh na paain mugadh nar sa(n)t naal khaha(n)de ||
lines.translation: The foolish people, who fight with the Saints, find no peace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਲੋਚਨਿ ਓਨਾ ਗੁਣਾ ਨੋ ਓਇ ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਸੜੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi lochan onaa gunaa no oi aha(n)kaar saRa(n)de ||
lines.translation: The Saints seek to bless them with virtue, but they are burning with egotism.

lines.gurmukhi: ਓਇ ਵੇਚਾਰੇ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਜਾਂ ਭਾਗ ਧੁਰਿ ਮੰਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: oi vechaare kiaa karahi jaa(n) bhaag dhur ma(n)de ||
lines.translation: What can those wretched ones do? Their evil destiny was pre-ordained.
